name: Launch collision avoidance screening
description: Screens a launch window: every liftoff time on a grid, every launched segment against every orbiting object, spherical or radial/in-track/cross-track ellipsoid criteria per object class. Returns prohibited liftoff spans and the worst approach of each run.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic geometry over caller-supplied Earth-fixed ephemerides. No host calls, threads, propagation or network access.

inputPorts.description: $CQR with LAUNCH_REQUEST: window, liftoff step, segments (Earth-fixed OEM relative to the nominal liftoff), orbiting objects as Earth-fixed ephemerides, one criterion per object class.

outputPorts.description: $CQR with LAUNCH_RESULT: merged prohibited liftoff spans and the worst approach of every run.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (module-sdk runtime type FNTC), KIND Info, SCHEMA $CQR, REASON launch-window-screened: ITEMS the merged closure intervals as ISO 8601 start/end text for the launch notice, COUNT the violating approaches (coordinated rendezvous excluded). The scientific result, with liftoff and approach counts, is the $CQR frame.

outputPorts.description: FlowNotice (module-sdk runtime type FNTC), KIND Info, SCHEMA $CQR, REASON launch-window-screened: ITEMS the merged closure intervals as ISO 8601 start/end text for the launch notice, COUNT the violating approaches (coordinated rendezvous excluded). The scientific result, with liftoff and approach counts, is the $CQR frame.
